songs.title: Wings Like Eagles
songs.note: Isaiah 40 — the promise that the ones who wait get to fly.

verse.text: 30 Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall. 31 But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.

lines.text: Verse 1
When the road is long and the night is cold
And the weight I carry’s more than I can hold
When I’ve given all and there’s nothing left
Just a whispered prayer on a tired breath
Pre-Chorus
But I heard a promise
Older than the sky
Those who wait on You
Get to learn to fly
Chorus
Wings like eagles
You lift me high
When my strength is gone
You give me the sky
I will run, not grow weary
I will walk, and not faint
Wings like eagles
You lift me high
Verse 2
Have you not heard, have you not known
The Everlasting never sleeps alone
He gives the tired a brand new day
And the weak find power when they wait
Pre-Chorus
So I lay my worry
Down on the floor
Those who wait on You
Rise up and soar
Chorus
Wings like eagles
You lift me high
When my strength is gone
You give me the sky
I will run, not grow weary
I will walk, and not faint
Wings like eagles
You lift me high
Bridge
Even the young ones stumble
Even the strong fall down
But I’m waiting on the One
Who never lets me hit the ground
Final Chorus
Wings like eagles
You lift me high
When my strength is gone
You give me the sky
I will run, not grow weary
I will walk, and not faint
Wings like eagles
You lift me high
You lift me high
You lift me high

songs.title: My Times Are in Your Hand
songs.note: David — the sling, the cave, and the trust that held through all of it.

verse.text: 14 But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.” 15 My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

lines.text: Verse 1
Little brother with a sling and stones
Nobody sent for him, he came alone
Giant on the hillside, army full of fear
He said, “The Lord who saved me from the lion, He is here”
Chorus
I’ll not be afraid
The Lord is my light
Though an army rise against me
I will trust You in the night
You’ve been faithful before
So I’ll wait, and I’ll stand
For my times are in Your hand
Verse 2
Years in the wilderness, running from the king
Hiding in the caves with only songs to sing
He could have taken vengeance, had the chance in his hand
But he said, “The Lord will judge — I’ll wait on His plan”
Chorus
I’ll not be afraid
The Lord is my light
Though an army rise against me
I will trust You in the night
You’ve been faithful before
So I’ll wait, and I’ll stand
For my times are in Your hand
Bridge
Though I walk through the valley
Through the shadow and the pain
You prepare a table for me
And You call me by my name
Verse 3
I’ve got giants of my own, and I’ve got caves I hide in too
Got a heart that keeps on running when I should be still with You
So I’ll take the shepherd’s confidence and make it mine today
If You brought him through, You’ll bring me through — I’ll walk the shepherd’s way
Final Chorus
I’ll not be afraid
The Lord is my light
Though an army rise against me
I will trust You in the night
You’ve been faithful before
So I’ll wait, and I’ll stand
For my times are in Your hand
For my times are in Your hand

songs.title: He Reached Out
songs.note: Peter on the water — sinking, three words, and a hand already reaching.

verse.text: 30 But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!” 31 Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”

lines.text: Verse 1
Storm on the water, wind in the sail
Twelve men rowing and about to fail
Then You came walking on the waves
“Don’t be afraid” — that’s what You gave
Chorus
You reach out, You reach out
When I’m going under
You reach out, You reach out
Through the wind and thunder
I’m not gonna drown, no, I’m not gonna drown
You reach out and You lift me now
Verse 2
Peter said “Lord, call me to You”
Stepped off the boat and walked on through
Then he saw the wind and started down
Three words — “Lord, save me” — and You were around
Chorus
You reach out, You reach out
When I’m going under
You reach out, You reach out
Through the wind and thunder
I’m not gonna drown, no, I’m not gonna drown
You reach out and You lift me now
Bridge
Eyes on the waves, and I start to sink
Eyes on Your face, and I can walk, I think
So I’m stepping out of the boat today
‘Cause You’re standing on the thing I fear
And You’re calling me Your way
Final Chorus
You reach out, You reach out
When I’m going under
You reach out, You reach out
Through the wind and thunder
I’m not gonna drown, no, I’m not gonna drown
You reach out and You lift me now
(You reach out) You lift me now
(You reach out) I’m walking now

songs.title: Clouds of Glory
songs.note: The second coming — the sky opening and every eye lifting to watch.

verse.text: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.

lines.text: Verse 1
The sky went still at dawn
Like it was holding breath
The hills wore out their color
Waiting on Your step
Old promises were ringing
Through the dust and bone
And every heart was leaning
Toward the coming throne
Pre-Chorus
Lift up your eyes
Look to the light
Heaven is moving
Right before our sight
Chorus
Jesus is coming
Riding on clouds
Jesus is coming
Every knee bows down
Power in His hands
Glory in His face
Everyone can see
Everyone can see
Verse 2
The graves will hear Your voice
The dead will rise and stand
The proud will lose their crowns
Before the pierced hands
The lonely will be gathered
The tears will run dry
And every tongue will answer
When You fill the sky
Pre-Chorus
Lift up your eyes
Look to the light
Heaven is moving
Right before our sight
Chorus
Jesus is coming
Riding on clouds
Jesus is coming
Every knee bows down
Power in His hands
Glory in His face
Everyone can see
Everyone can see
Bridge
Trumpets in the morning
Echo through the blue
Creation wakes and trembles
When You make all things new
The Lamb is on the throne now
Forever He will reign
Every tongue will sing it
Jesus comes again
Chorus
Jesus is coming
Riding on clouds
Jesus is coming
Every knee bows down
Power in His hands
Glory in His face
Everyone can see
Everyone can see
Clouds of glory
Cover the world
Clouds of glory
Jesus, You are Lord

songs.title: Faithful
songs.note: Inspired by the story of Joseph — faithful in the pit long before the palace.

verse.text: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.

lines.text: Verse 1
They tore the colours off his back
And sold him where the road runs dry,
Seventeen and everything gone
But the God who heard him cry.
He didn’t curse the caravan,
He didn’t waste away —
He served in a stranger’s house
Like it was the Father’s way.
Chorus
Faithful in the pit, faithful on the throne,
Faithful when the dream is all he’s got to hold.
Same heart in the shadow, same heart in the sun —
Lord, make me faithful when it’s not yet won.
Verse 2
He walked away from an open door
And it cost him everything,
Two more years in a borrowed cell
With no one remembering.
And when they came to hear their dreams
He gave the glory back:
“It isn’t me, it’s God who speaks” —
He never once looked back.
Chorus
Bridge
Not the palace, not the ring,
Not the second-highest name —
Give me the man in the ordinary years
Who served the very same.
When the promise is slow
And the pit is deep and wide,
Let me keep my hands clean
And keep my God beside.
Verse 3
Face to face with the ones who sold him,
Bread in his open hand:
“You meant it for evil, but God meant good —
He brought me to this land.”
He wept on the necks of the men who broke him,
Held them to his chest.
That’s the strength I’m asking for,
That’s the harder test.
Final Chorus
Faithful in the pit, faithful on the throne,
Faithful in the famine and the seven years alone.
Same heart in the shadow, same heart in the sun —
Lord, make me faithful,
Lord, make me faithful,
Lord, make me faithful when it’s not yet won.

songs.title: Oh My Soul
songs.note: Built on the old line “it is well with my soul” — peace that holds in the calm and the storm.

verse.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

lines.text: Verse 1
When the day comes easy and the river runs slow,
or the hard news lands like a stone,
whatever the weather, there’s one thing I know —
and my soul, oh my soul, it is well.
Chorus 1
Oh my soul, it is well,
oh my soul, it is well —
I don’t have to carry the whole world alone.
Come the calm or the storm, come the wind or the cold,
oh my soul, oh my soul, it is well.
Verse 2
And oh, what a thought — every wrong thing I’ve done,
all of it, not just a part,
was left at the cross and it’s gone, it is gone,
and my soul, oh my soul, it is well.
Chorus 2
Oh my soul, it is well,
oh my soul, it is well —
nothing left to prove and nothing I owe.
Come the calm or the storm, come whatever may go,
oh my soul, oh my soul, it is well.
Bridge
One day the sky’s gonna open up wide
and I’ll see with my eyes what I’ve held in the dark —
till then I’ll keep singing it low,
through the night, through the morning: my soul, it is well.
Chorus 3
Oh my soul, it is well,
oh my soul, it is well —
however it lands, however it goes.
Come the calm or the storm, come the high or the low,
oh my soul, oh my soul, it is well.
Oh my soul (oh my soul),
it is well (it is well)…

songs.title: Be Strong
songs.note: Joshua at the Jordan — the water only parts once the feet step in.

verse.text: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

lines.text: Verse 1
Forty years of circling sand,
Waiting on a promised land.
Then the word came sharp and clear:
"Rise up now and cross from here."
Every place your foot will fall
I have given you — take it all.
Pre-Chorus
And the river's high, and the river's wide,
And it's flood-stage deep on the other side.
But the ark goes first and the priests go in —
The water only breaks when the feet begin.
Chorus
Be strong, be courageous,
Do not be afraid.
Wherever I have sent you
I have gone ahead.
Have I not commanded you?
Do not be dismayed.
The Lord your God is with you
Every step you take.
Verse 2
There's a wall in front of me I cannot climb,
So I walk it silent, one more time.
No sword drawn, no clever plan,
Just the sound of feet and a sounding horn —
Not by my strength, not by my hand;
Seven days till the shout is born.
Bridge
"Are you for us, or for our enemies?"
He said, "Neither — I am the Captain of the host."
So I fall down, take the sandals off my feet,
This ground is holy, and the fight is not my own.
Final Chorus
Be strong, be courageous,
Do not be afraid.
Not one word has failed you,
Not one promise frayed.
Have I not commanded you?
Do not turn away —
As for me and this house, this heart, this day,
We will serve the Lord.
Be strong, be strong, be courageous,
The Lord your God is with you.
Be strong, be strong, be courageous,
Wherever you may go.

songs.title: Stand Still and See
songs.note: Jehoshaphat facing an army he cannot beat, sending the singers out ahead of the soldiers.

verse.text: You need not fight this battle. Take up your positions, stand firm, and see the salvation of the LORD on your behalf, O Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid or discouraged. Go out and face them tomorrow, for the LORD is with you.’”

lines.text: Verse 1
A shadow on the eastern hills, a thousand banners rise
The sound of coming armies, terror in our eyes
So we called upon the fast, and we gathered every one
Lord, we have no power here, but we look to You alone
Pre-Chorus
We don't know what to do
But our eyes are fixed on You
Chorus
Stand still and see, stand still and see
The battle is not ours to fight, it belongs to the King
Lay down the sword, lift up the song
Salvation of the Lord is marching strong
Stand still, stand still and see
Verse 2
Then the Spirit fell at morning, on a voice within the crowd
Do not fear this multitude, go down and stand your ground
So we sent the singers first, before the shield and spear
Praise the Lord, His mercy stands, His love endures forever here
Pre-Chorus
We don't know what to do
But our eyes are fixed on You
Chorus
Stand still and see, stand still and see
The battle is not ours to fight, it belongs to the King
Lay down the sword, lift up the song
Salvation of the Lord is marching strong
Stand still, stand still and see
Bridge
As the praise began to rise, the enemy was overthrown
In the Valley of Blessing, we bowed before the throne
For three days we gathered more than our hands could ever hold
The song became the victory, the story still is told
Final Chorus
Stand still and see, stand still and see
The battle is not ours to fight, it belongs to the King
Lay down the sword, lift up the song
Salvation of the Lord is marching strong
Stand still, stand still and see

songs.title: Handing It Over
songs.note: A week that got too heavy, and the decision to stop carrying it alone.

verse.text: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

lines.text: Verse 1
Monday took my courage, Tuesday brought the rain,
By Friday I was carrying more than I could sustain.
I held on to my worries, afraid to let them go,
Then I heard Your quiet whisper, “You don’t have to walk alone.”
Pre-Chorus
I’ve fought this battle long enough,
Lord, I’m giving up control.
Chorus
Handing it over, laying it down,
Laying every burden at Your feet.
Handing it over, trusting you now
Finding perfect peace instead of fear.
You were waiting all along,
To carry what I couldn’t hold.
Handing it over, leaving it with you
Into Your hands, I’m letting go.
Verse 2
Nothing’s really changed yet, the mountain’s standing tall,
But somehow in Your presence it doesn’t seem so small.
I don’t need tomorrow when I know You’re here today;
Your peace is more than enough to light the narrow way.
Bridge
You never asked me to be strong enough,
Only faithful enough to trust Your love.
Final Chorus
Handing it over, resting in you,
Every fear and every hope.
Handing it over, one prayer at a time,
You’re carrying the heavy load.
When my heart wants to hold on tight,
Your love reminds me to let go.
Handing it over, I'm letting go,
Lord, I’m finally ...
finally handing it over.

songs.title: Before the Day Begins
songs.note: Morning prayer in the quiet, before the phone starts ringing.

verse.text: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

lines.text: Verse 1
Before the sun has climbed the window
Before the phone begins to ring
I am here in borrowed silence
Listening for the smallest thing
Pre-Chorus
And all the mountains I have yet to climb
Grow small and quiet in the morning light
Chorus
Hey now, hey now — I'm handing it over
Everything waiting, everything wide
Hey now, hey now — I'm not walking alone now
You go before me, You stay by my side
Verse 2
Give me the courage of the sparrow
Who sings before the coming storm
Give me a heart that walks the valley
Trusting I am kept from harm
Pre-Chorus
And all the questions I have learned to hold
Melt like the frost when the day turns gold
Chorus
Hey now, hey now — I'm handing it over
Everything waiting, everything wide
Hey now, hey now — I'm not walking alone now
You go before me, You stay by my side
Bridge
Let it come, let it come, the long day
Let it break like a wave on the shore
I have set my anchor deeper
I have been here in Your peace before
Chorus
Hey now, hey now — I'm handing it over
Everything waiting, everything wide
Hey now, hey now — I'm not walking alone now
You go before me, You stay by my side

songs.title: Cast the Net of Mercy
songs.note: Dawn on the shore of Galilee — “leave your nets and follow me.”

verse.text: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”

lines.text: Verse 1
By the waters of Galilee, in the breaking of the dawn,
Nets were heavy with the labor of a night that had gone on.
Then a voice came through the silence, calling simple working men,
“Leave your nets and come and follow, I’ll make you fishers of men.”
Pre-Chorus
Not by power, not by riches,
Not by wisdom of our own,
But by grace that seeks the lost ones,
And by love that leads them home.
Chorus
We will cast the net of mercy,
We will shine the Savior’s light,
Calling hearts from stormy waters,
Leading souls through darkest night.
Jesus, guide us where You send us,
Till Your kingdom fills the land,
Making us Your faithful fishers,
Holding every life in hand.
Verse 2
Through the towns and through the valleys, by the shore and on the sea,
Jesus walked among the broken, setting captives truly free.
Every word a seed of heaven, every touch a healing flame,
And He calls His church to follow, bearing witness in His name.
Pre-Chorus
For the harvest fields are waiting,
And the days are passing by,
May we hear the Master’s calling,
May we answer, “Here am I.”
Chorus
We will cast the net of mercy,
We will shine the Savior’s light,
Calling hearts from stormy waters,
Leading souls through darkest night.
Jesus, guide us where You send us,
Till Your kingdom fills the land,
Making us Your faithful fishers,
Holding every life in hand.
Bridge
Though the seas are rough around us,
Though the winds and waves may rise,
You are Lord above the waters,
You are strength when courage dies.
Let the net be filled with nations,
Every tribe and tongue and shore,
Till the world has heard the story
Of the One we’re living for.
Final Chorus
We will cast the net of mercy,
We will lift the cross on high,
Pointing every soul to Jesus,
Who was lifted up to die.
And when all our work is finished,
At Your throne we’ll gladly stand,
Thankful that You chose and sent us,
As Your fishers of all men.

verse.text: 1 The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. 2 He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters. 3 He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name. 4 Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me. 5 You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows. 6 Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

lines.text: Verse 1
The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want
He makes me lie down in pastures so green
He leads me beside the still, gentle streams
He restores my soul, He restores my soul
Chorus
You are my shepherd, I will not fear
Valley of shadows, I know You are near
Goodness and mercy follow my days
Shepherd of my soul, I sing Your praise
Verse 2
He guides me along the paths that are right
For the sake of His name I walk in His light
Though I walk through the dark, shadowed vale
You are with me there, You will never fail
Bridge
Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me
You prepare a table where my foes can see
My cup overflows, Your love is my song
In Your house forever, I will belong
